question: restaurants near the Tagus River
sql: SELECT p.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING(-9.15 38.7, -9.1 38.7)', 4326))

question: buildings with height over 50 meters
sql: SELECT b.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_buildings b WHERE b.height > 50.0

question: residential buildings within 1 km of Alfama district
sql: SELECT b.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_buildings b WHERE b.subtype = 'residential' AND ST_Distance(b.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT(-9.1393 38.7073)', 4326), true) < 1000

question: places that touch the Lisbon Cathedral
sql: SELECT p.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p WHERE ST_Touches(p.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_places WHERE names->>'primary' = 'Lisbon Cathedral'))

question: historic sites inside the city center
sql: SELECT p.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.taxonomy->'primary' = 'historic_site' AND ST_Within(p.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.15 38.7, -9.15 38.8, -9.09 38.8, -9.09 38.7, -9.15 38.7))', 4326))

question: commercial buildings taller than 30 meters
sql: SELECT b.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_buildings b WHERE b.subtype = 'commercial' AND b.height > 30.0
